en: You called, Lady? Hi guys.
Heya!
I've brought you all here to discuss the storehouse raid.
The storehouse? We can't do that shit without bringing the whole damn guard down on us.
Ever thought of just showing them your tits? It worked for me when blue and I went there last time.
No, 'cause I'm not a slut.
Wait. You were both in the storehouse before?
Yeah! Was fairly easy actually.
I've got a way with men.
Damn, girl. You sure do.
You done sucking her off?
Hey, I'm just agreeing with her!
Hmph.
Back on topic.
How did you manage to infiltrate the place?
I fucked all the guards while blue went to grab the bottle of alcohol she needed.
You went through all that trouble for a single bottle of alcohol?
It's a long story.
Hell, I would've done it for free.
So we let Ms. Jewel take care of all the guards and then we just waltz in? Damn, I'd sure love to stick around and watch in that case.
You can do much more than just watch, big guy.
Goddamn...
Uggh...
Ahem! P-Perhaps that may b-be the wisest c-choice of action.
It won't work.
Why not?
Security's been tightened up since then. The whole guard is on edge especially with Wildfire going missing. They won't just let us all waltz in.
So another plan is in order.
Got any other bright ideas, slutty girl?
Sofie, be nice please.
I am being nice!
Maybe we can just sneak right in at night?
We'd need the key to the storehouse. They lock it up each night.
Do you not have the key?
Only the captain has it now. He's a bit of a testy fellow. He does seem to like the bar though... I remember him mentioning how much he loves the food.
Wait... I think I know that one. He doesn't like me that much.
I wonder why.
Said something about not liking assertive girls.
But oh well, that's his loss.
Sure is.
Perhaps Jenna might have better luck?
W- Me?
Oh hoh. I'd love to see that.
Agreed.
That might actually work. If Jenna can get close to the guy, she might be able to swipe the key off him and make a copy before he knows what happened.
We ha-have a d-device that m-may assist w-with copying the k-key. T-Take this... All you n-need to do is s-swipe it over the k-key and it will c-copy it.
Be nervous.
<color=perversion>Be horny.</color>
He hands me a strange little keycard reading device.
Be nervous.
<color=perversion>Be horny.</color>
<color=perversion>Sounds like fun~</color>
Damn right. Atta girl.
Sluuuts!
Shh!
C-Can't anyone else do it?
We can't even show our faces above ground, let alone slut out for some guy.
And I can't do it this time, blue. Sorry, hun.
Right... I guess I'll try at least...
It's decided then. The first step will be acquiring the key from this guard. We'll start making preparations while we wait for you, Jenna.
How am I even going to get close to this guy?
Ooh! I've got an idea for that! I'm gonna head over to the bar! Come meet me there, blue!
... She seems more excited than usual...
Alright, pal. I've been wiping the floor with your little gang. I'm gonna make this easy now. Gimme the holo bandana things you guys got and I'll leave.
W- How ye' be knowin' abou' the bandanas? Ol' Ray an' the boys (an' girls)'ll be havin' ye for breakfast, ye dodgy slag!
Yeah, you'll be having breakfast alright. We're serving knuckle sandwiches today.
GET 'EM, BOYS (an' girls)!
Argh! Damn wench be beatin' ol Ray an' the boys (an' girls) again!
Now tell us where your bandanas are, pal.
Grrr... Fine. It only be fair since ye' beat us an' all.
That's what I was thinking too.
I'll take her to them.
Aye. Take 'er.
My pleasure~ Come on, girlie~ Let's get your bandanas.
Jenna? Can talk?
What's up?
People being... hard.
I guess I can try to talk to them.
Jenna! It's been a while! How was the outside?
Oh! Uh... It was alright!
That sounds wonderful! Was the sun nice?
Err... Yeah! It was pretty nice, not too cloudy.
Wow! I would love to see it someday.
You act like you haven't seen it before. You've been out of plenty of times!
I have? I guess I have seen bits of it from the memories of some of my offspring who made it outside this base.
No, I mean like... with your own eyes.
I haven't. I've just been breeding soldiers for those monsters for as long as I can remember...
I'm sorry... Maybe we can fix that?
We can't risk the GAG seeing her...
I just want to see it. Is that too much to ask? Just a peek! HQ has been telling me that I can't, but I just want out of this prison.
Okay, okay. I understand. We'll try to figure something out for you.
That's all I want.
Carcen! Rida happy to see!
Hey, Rida. How's it goin' with you?
Smart Hen not let us leave. Rida not like tiny room. Rida exercising.
But Rida like sex with plant girl.
Eheh... At least there's a silver lining.
... and Rida miss tribe.
Oh...
Not sure how to help with that.
Tribe hated Rida... Rida never knew...
I'm sure they still love you...
Hate Rida.
When we were escaping the place, Mina told them all that we were kidnapping you. That's why they came at us so hard.
... Tribe not hate Rida?
Didn't seem like it. It seemed like Mina was just... turning them against us.
Rida still love Mina...
I'm sorry...
Rida fine. No need Mina. No need tribe. Rida strong.
Rida strong.
Mm...
Hi Karen... I hope things are doing better in here. I'm sorry that my actions lead to all this, but I'm doing my best to make them better.
I know it's difficult right now, but I think things are gonna get better. I just want us to be on the same side again.
Err... You awake?
Errm... HQ disable helmet and put on Karen to... keep Karen quiet. We needed sleep. HQ fix...
-UCKING CUNT! YOU THINK? DID YOU THINK WHEN YOU FUCKED MY LIFE OVER?
Ah... She do this a lot.
You've got a lot of fucking nerve to lock me up like this and try to make it seem like it's for my own good.
We both know you're just doing this for you! You always do things for you!
For me?! Ever since you were taken, my focus has been solely on you!
Err... Maybe we should cool it down a bit...
OH HAS IT NOW? Yeah, that really fucking makes me feel better about the years of torture you sentenced me to!
PEITHO DID THAT TO YOU! ALL I WANT IS FOR YOU TO BE SAFE AND HAPPY, SO GET THE FUCK OFF MY CASE!
YOU'RE A CANCER! I CAN'T WAIT FOR THE DAY THAT I CAN BURN YOU OUT!
Peitho is the cancer. They're the ones that did this to you. Fuck, they did the same thing to the whole fucking world.
She does have a point. They did horrible things to me too.
Going against them will only bring more pain and suffering. Is that what you want? You want people to suffer?
They're already suffering. I'm just trying to help everyone.
You call this helping? Locking us in a tiny room with barely enough food to survive?
I'm doing the best I fucking can here! It's Peitho's fault that we're stuck down here! If they weren't around, we'd be able to go wherever the fuck we want!
Keep telling yourself that, you bitch.
Are you finished? Everything I've done so far has been for you.
We really don't have time for this... Not with Pyra around...
Pyra is here?
You know her?
Barely... but she knows everyone.
Once they let her get a hold of me... she knew everything...
I'll get her back for that.
... like that.
But don't get any ideas!
Blue... The bandanas.
Yeah. Let's head out.
Lady, we've got a big probl-
Did you copy the keycard?
We did, but we almost got caught.
Caught? By whom?
Some chick that they call Pyra. She was sucking up people's memories left and right. We had a close call.
Commander Pyra is here? Shit...
If she gets a hold of any of us, the whole gig is up.
Yes, I know. Pyra is the GAG's number one investigator. With those empathy powers of hers, she's been able to tear apart resistance cells in other towns.
She's also a hell of a fighter. Those vials she carries has the fluids of unique powered individuals so she can sample their powers in combat.
We've gotta call off this whole raid. It's too dangerous with her around!
It seems so... We'll have to find another way to get the supplies we need.
Wait... But what happens if you can't get them?
We'll starve...
Well that's not an option.
We're out of options.
We still have an option. Let's do the raid. We can't let one woman stop us.
She's singlehandedly stopped many before.
So have I.
Blue...
The way I see it, we've got two options: Give in, or fight. I choose to fight. I'll never give in, and I won't let you give in either. We're doing the raid.
... You're right.
I love it when blue gets assertive.
Alright... We'll do the raid, but we still need to prepare for it.
So what's the next step then?
We'll need to cover our identities. With Pyra around, any pair of eyes that sees us is a danger.
How do we do that? I guess you won't need much help.
Holo-Bandanas, or HOLOs. They project a fake identity around you to all except others wearing bandanas keyed to the same frequency.
Say that in English, please?
Bandanas give a fake face. Allies don't see the fake face.
Well why didn't you just say that?
Where can we find them?
The local gang in town has been known to use them to aid in their anarchy.
The Lumber Rats?
Indeed.
So we just knock down their front door and grab a bunch of those bandanas?
Correct.
Sounds easy enough when blue puts it like that.
Welp. Let's do it. Got nothing else we can do.
We'll be right back with those bandanas.
We got the bandanas you needed!
Perfect. Let me get the others.
Hey, you three! How were the fetch quests?
Could've been a little more lively in some places.
But we got what was needed. So now we should move on to the next part of this raid?
Did ya suck that one guy's dick?
I did much more than that.
Sluuuut! That's not pure!
Sofie... Come on. Cut her a break.
I uh... heh... Not really.
Suuuuure~
Sofie... Come on. Cut her a break...
Hmph...
Nope. Didn't have to resort to any of that.
She was quite the smooth talker. I was impressed.
Damn! Good job, Ms. Jenna!
Hmmph. You win this time.
Nah,  I didn't. But he sure wanted one after I was done with him.
Sluuuut!
Good girl.
Yeah, I did. So what?
Groooss! Sluuuut!
Now, now, Sof. Cut her a break.
I am!
Anyways...
Let's go over the next part of the plan.
E-Ehem. Those b-bandanas will m-mask your identities for the d-duration of the m-mission. B-But if all goes w-well... you w-will not need t-them.
You'll be infiltrating the storehouse at night using the keycard that you acquired from that guard captain. You'll be grabbing supplies from the boxes.
E-Each box s-should have a t-tracking ch-chip in i-it that will a-allow you to f-find it. I h-have trackers f-for each o-of you.
I won't be needing that. Already got a tracker.
O-Oh! Hm. A-Alright. Well e-each chip in the b-box has i-information like w-what it contains. W-We'll w-want to get certain supplies from each b-box.
Altin will be monitoring and will update your trackers once you get the supplies we need out of each box.
Sounds easy enough!
Any questions?
Seems simple enough to me!
Good. Then we'll wait for the right time to strike. I'd ask that you all stay here with us.
Err... We can't just stay.
Yeah, we have obligations. We can't just hide away. It'd bring too much attention.
But I can.
Fine. You two can go back. Jenna, you'll stay with us.
Sounds good to me.
Alright. That's all I had to say. You two check back with us before tonight.
Okay.
Got it, boss.
Alright. Arnold. Take her to her resting spot.
Aye aye, Lady! Come on, Miss Jenna!
Alright. This is your spot for sleeping. It's not much, but it's home.
Thanks, Arnold!
No problem! So if you wanna sleep right away, you can. But uh... I mean if you wanna do some... working out before the big raid. Just come see me!
Working out? Is that supposed to be a sex thing?
Oh hell no! You think I got these bad boys by just fucking around?
And since I see you've got some pretty bad boys of your own, I figured you'd wanna work on 'em.
Thanks for the offer! I'll think about it.
Alright! I'll leave you to it!
Do you want to rest until the raid?
Rest until the raid.
Cancel.
